text:
incident-bot: Paging: High 5xx rate observed from gateway-prod, 19:05 UTC. Threshold breach: 5xx rate > 3% (last 5m). Pager: oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: Acked. Jumping in — checking dashboards and recent deploys.

cheng: seeing a spike primarily in edge->model-proxy timeouts, lots of 504s. KC backend 502s also tick up.

alice-plat: No deploys from platform in the last hour. Release-bot shows no recent canary promotions.

eng-sre-mohit: grabbing traces now. Early signal: connection resets to model-proxy pool, increased latency on setup handshake.

support-emily: Customer impact: a handful of API errors reported in support queue, about ~8 tickets in last 10m, some retries succeed.

ops-lead-sarah: Is this regional? Any datacenter skew?

cheng: Mostly us-east-1 and eu-west-1. ap-south-1 looks fine.

oncall-ryan: temp mitigation plan: 1) Expand circuit-breaker to reject quickly for degraded model-proxy hosts. 2) Reroute traffic off the suspected model-proxy pool to standby pool. 3) Reduce fanout to OTLP to avoid extra connections.

eng-sre-mohit: On it — adjusting routing policy now. Patch for circuit-breaker pushed to staging, applying to prod with low concurrency. Command: ```/apply-config route:gateway->model-proxy circuit_breaker_threshold=0.05```

incident-bot: Deploy started for config: route-cb-0.05 by eng-sre-mohit.

alice-plat: I triggered a manual reroute for 20% of traffic away from pool-a -> pool-b to reduce backend pressure. Observing drop in 5xx as we reroute.

eng-sre-mohit: After config roll: 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% in 3m. Latency medians back to normal. Holding for 10m to confirm.

support-emily: Notifying impacted customers that we're investigating; no ETA yet.

ops-lead-sarah: Good. action: create a postmortem and identify why pool-a degraded. Could be connection pool exhaustion or a kernel upgrade? Any recent infra churn?

cheng: Host-level metrics show elevated ephemeral port usage on pool-a, and a restart of a subset of model-proxy pods around 18:58 UTC from kube-eviction after OOMs. That likely amplified connection churn.

oncall-ryan: Root-cause hypothesis: OOM-triggered restarts caused connection resets -> queue backlog -> timeouts -> traffic fanout made it worse. Temporary mitigation succeeded.

eng-sre-mohit: I'll open a hotfix PR to make model-proxy handle transient restarts more gracefully (increase keepalive and backoff), and tune the node-level OOM thresholds. Drafting now.

incident-bot: Hotfix PR #842 opened by eng-sre-mohit: "model-proxy: backoff on reset, increase keepalive"

alice-plat: While hotfix lands, recommend adjusting alerting: lower the 5m 5xx threshold trigger to 2% and add a short suppression window for planned restarts to avoid noisy pages.

ops-lead-sarah: Agree. Also add runbook step: on pool host restarts, immediately scale standby pool and reduce fanout for 10m.

support-emily: I'll prepare a canned status update for affected customers: short note, we have mitigations in place and root-cause investigation ongoing.

oncall-ryan: Post-incident actions: 1) Ship hotfix PR and canary to prod (owner: eng-sre-mohit). 2) Runbook update for "pool restart -> scale standby" (owner: alice-plat). 3) Alert tuning: 5xx threshold and restart suppression (owner: ops-lead-sarah). 4) Customer comms follow-up and list of affected accounts (owner: support-emily). 5) RCA doc (owner: cheng).

eng-sre-mohit: Hotfix merged to main and canary started at 19:28 UTC. Monitoring canary pools now.

incident-bot: Canary success metric: no elevated 5xx over 12m in canary traffic.

oncall-ryan: Rolling full rollout at 19:40 UTC with staged percentage increases.

alice-plat: Rollout complete by 19:52 UTC. Final 5xx rate stable at 0.6%.

support-emily: Support notify: initial batch of customers updated at 19:35 UTC, follow-up note prepared once RCA is ready.

ops-lead-sarah: Good recovery. We'll keep the channel open for follow-ups and close after the RCA and runbook updates land.

cheng: Creating RCA doc now with timelines, metric charts, and recommended infra changes.

eng-sre-mohit: Action: add exponential backoff in connection manager and increase ephemeral port pool on nodes; testing in staging.

oncall-ryan: TL;DR for pager: caused by cascading backpressure from unexpected pod restarts -> connection churn -> timeouts. Mitigated via circuit-breaker, reroute, hotfix. Post-incident actions assigned.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by oncall-ryan at 19:52 UTC. Severity: Sev2.

ops-lead-sarah: Follow-ups due EOD tomorrow for hotfix verification and runbook PR. Closing channel for active mitigation but keep thread for notes. :white_check_mark:
